name: colCummins
title: Cumulative minima for each column in a matrix

origin.description: Cumulative minima for each column in a matrix.
origin.usage:
colCummins(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, dim. = dim(x), ...,
  useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An NxK matrix or, if dim. is specified, an N * K vector.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: dim.
arguments.text: An integer vector of length two specifying the dimension of x, also when not a matrix. The argument is named with a period so it does not clash with dim.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: The minimum is cumulative down the rows of each selected column, in the order of rows. A missing value makes that cell and every cell below it in the column missing. Logical input is returned as integer.
origin.value: A numeric NxK matrix of the same mode as x, except when x is logical, in which case the result is integer.

translation.description: Cumulative minima for each column in a matrix.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A 2-d array whose axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix. A 1-d vector is accepted when dim is set; it is filled column-major, as R stores a matrix. Logical and integer values stay integers. Floating values are computed as float64.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based row subscripts. None selects every row. The cumulative minimum walks the selected rows in this order. Zeros are dropped, negatives exclude, and logical values are recycled.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based column subscripts. None selects every column.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the number of rows and columns. This is dim. in R. None uses the shape of a 2-d x. A 1-d x is filled in column-major order.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for the R argument useNames. The result is a plain array, with no names attached.

translation.details: The running minimum lives in the Rust crate rowcummins, ported from matrixStats src/rowCummins.c with byrow FALSE. A NaN, the stand-in for R's double NA, ends that column: the current cell and every cell below it are NaN. Integer and logical input use the integer routine. Logical values are 0 and 1. The int32 value -2147483648 is R's NA_integer_ and ends the column the same way.
translation.value: An array of shape (N, K), one row for each selected row and one column for each selected column. Floating input returns float64. Integer and logical input return int32.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowcummins import colCummins

x = np.arange(1, 13).reshape((4, 3), order="F")
colCummins(x)
